bends.note: turns from south-east to nearly due east
west end turns north-west as a 25 ft leg up to Joe Williams Street
north-west side swings north and the street widens into Blue Rock Street

ends.note: lot lines stop; open works ground to the north (a 4 in. water pipe runs on to about y 2080)
60 ft stub east of Lakeman Street stops at the green property boundary

notes: Solid lines running inside the streets and branching at crossings are water pipes, not edges; centres were taken between lot lines. The street through Witler and Lakeman carries only the word STREET in this strip; its name is printed far to the west near (3550,310) and reads HANIFIELD (the instructions call it Hanfield Street). Chase Avenue lies along the top plate edge: only its south side, sewer and pipe show, centre taken at the sewer line (about y 38); Lakeman may or may not continue north of it. Witler Street runs off the top of the plate before reaching Chase Avenue. Joe Williams Street meets Blue Rock Street in a wide skew mouth (south-edge corners about 7812,3155 and 8015,3240); the pick is a compromise between the straight centre line extended (about 8053,3156) and the middle of the mouth. The 25 ft leg from Joe Williams Street to the west end of McMakin Street has no separate name and is taken as McMakin Street. McMakin Street is about 25 ft wide west of Delaney and 12 ft wide east of it. Hoffner Avenue is offset at Colerain Avenue: the 55 ft west arm centre meets Colerain at about (8093,5318), the 60 ft east arm at about (8031,5214); one pick at the middle. Powers Street likewise: the diagonal west arm meets Colerain at about (8970,6931), the east arm at about (9007,7003); one pick at the middle. Cooper Street meets Colerain Avenue under the Baltimore and Ohio tracks. WALKER near (9050,2810) is subdivision lettering at the back of lots, not a street. The 10 ft DRAINAGE strip between Witler and Lakeman near y 2030 is not a street.
